text:
Estimated from the photos, the tray held:

- Milk: a bottle of about 200 ml, probably whole or 2%, roughly 120 kcal (6 g protein, 9 g carbs, 6 g fat).
- Cornflakes: about 30–35 g, roughly 130 kcal (2.5 g protein, 29 g carbs, 0.3 g fat).
- Two fried or sunny-side-up eggs: about 90–100 kcal each, with a little added fat, so roughly 190 kcal (12.5 g protein, 1 g carbs, 15 g fat).
- Juice: about 180 ml of apple juice or tea-colored juice, roughly 85 kcal (0 g protein, 21 g carbs, 0 g fat).

Total served is about 525 kcal.

In the second photo, the milk, cereal, juice and eggs are all gone. Only a few small smears of yolk remain on the plate, which I put at about 10 kcal left over.

The person therefore ate about 515 kcal. Adding the macros above gives roughly 21 g protein, 60 g carbs and 21 g fat, which I trimmed slightly to account for the yolk left behind.
